path = get_data_file("cma-gfs")
source = from_source({"kind": "file", "path": str(path)})
path

# 按 CedarKit 要素名
fields = source.sel(
    parameter="w",
    level_type="pressure",
    level=[1000, 850, 70, 10],
    level_unit="hPa",
).all()
check_messages([224, 229, 249, 253], fields)

).all()
check_messages([224, 229, 249, 253], by_short_name)

check_messages([224, 229, 249, 253], by_grib)
